categories.evidence_required: Article text or a meaningful headline
categories.decision_rule: Return insufficient_text; count a missed positive as a failure
categories.confusing_negative: Markets moved.

categories.evidence_required: Distinct title/body passages
categories.decision_rule: Deduplicate passages before extracting evidence
categories.confusing_negative: Headline pasted twice as its body

categories.evidence_required: Complete scanner body and complete source views
categories.decision_rule: Do not apply character caps; expose upstream missing data
categories.confusing_negative: An excerpt falsely labeled complete
categories.when_missing: Mark incomplete; fail strict archive mode

categories.evidence_required: Pinned spelling and lemma resources
categories.decision_rule: Normalize spelling consistently on both sides
categories.confusing_negative: hour / our

categories.evidence_required: spaCy English lemma lookup plus dictionary fallback
categories.decision_rule: Map inflections to lemmas, preserving the surface in source evidence
categories.confusing_negative: Lockheed / lockh

categories.evidence_required: Explicit contextual lexical relation
categories.decision_rule: Do not collapse different derivatives into identity
categories.positive_example: administer associated with administration in a supporting context
categories.confusing_negative: administrator treated as the same object as administration

categories.evidence_required: WordNet sense gloss plus article context
categories.decision_rule: Select one strictly best-supported sense; synonyms alone cannot create multiple independent anchors
categories.confusing_negative: bank branch and riverbank
categories.when_missing: Keep literal term; abstain if ambiguous

categories.evidence_required: Dictionary identity or explicit semantic relation
categories.decision_rule: No spelling-distance expansion
categories.positive_example: frog / amphibian in a matching sense
categories.confusing_negative: frogman automatically treated as frog

categories.evidence_required: Contiguous tokens in the same sentence
categories.decision_rule: Keep phrases; never join across punctuation or stopword boundaries
categories.confusing_negative: rocket. Gasoline

categories.evidence_required: Two locally supported business anchors
categories.decision_rule: Match evidence per passage, not a mixed article-wide bag
categories.confusing_negative: office space; school launches a program
categories.when_missing: Sector context or no supported stock link

categories.evidence_required: Local passage context
categories.decision_rule: A verb occurrence cannot delete a noun elsewhere
categories.positive_example: plan to launch a website; rocket launch capacity expands
categories.confusing_negative: launch alone implies aerospace

categories.evidence_required: Publisher catalog and raw case-preserving identities
categories.decision_rule: Publisher tokens cannot create name hits
categories.confusing_negative: Washington Post reports local crime

categories.evidence_required: Company identity plus financial/business context
categories.decision_rule: Do not equate a foreign exchange symbol or agency with a US company
categories.confusing_negative: ICE arrests; Kosy (KOS) in Vietnam

categories.evidence_required: Full alias, legal marker, or supporting business terms
categories.decision_rule: A multiword company's first word is not a unique identity by itself
categories.confusing_negative: Schneider guidance on data centers implies Schneider National

categories.evidence_required: Ownership passage in the stock source plus article event
categories.decision_rule: Use the complete product identifier and unique evidenced owner
categories.confusing_negative: VOXZOGO silently becomes an ASND product

categories.evidence_required: Complete brand phrase
categories.decision_rule: Do not turn each acronym inside a product name into an owned brand
categories.confusing_negative: CNP alone treated as the owned branded product

categories.evidence_required: Exhibit 21 or explicit subsidiary ownership statement
categories.decision_rule: A subsidiary event can reach its evidenced parent
categories.confusing_negative: A partner's product treated as an owned subsidiary

categories.evidence_required: Named person in filings plus separate business evidence
categories.decision_rule: People trigger inspection; require corroborating business anchors
categories.confusing_negative: Musk mentioned without a company event

categories.evidence_required: Local first-use definition
categories.decision_rule: Store a typed acronym; it does not bypass relevance evidence
categories.positive_example: Defined platform acronym in a business event
categories.confusing_negative: FDA inferred to be a listed company's ticker

categories.evidence_required: Source section and relationship cue
categories.decision_rule: Keep customers, suppliers, partners and competitors out of owned core identity
categories.confusing_negative: Microsoft mention turns supplier's whole business into software
categories.when_missing: Preserve typed relation, no direct pass

categories.evidence_required: Explicit competition evidence, shared business exposure and a specific competitive event
categories.decision_rule: Competition may be material; do not confuse it with product ownership
categories.confusing_negative: Any competitor name anywhere passes
categories.when_missing: Inspection when material event not established

categories.evidence_required: Explicit sole/critical dependency plus actual disruptive event
categories.decision_rule: Material supply events can pass as tier 2; ordinary partner mentions remain tier 4
categories.confusing_negative: Partner merely mentioned in a gambling article

categories.evidence_required: Named place and dated operating exposure
categories.decision_rule: Place is a scope/inspection signal, never sufficient evidence
categories.positive_example: Rule affecting an evidenced operating jurisdiction
categories.confusing_negative: Charlotte police implies Duke Energy
categories.when_missing: Inspection; do not infer operational exposure from an absent source

categories.evidence_required: Action and matching business exposure in the same passage
categories.decision_rule: Do not combine unrelated clauses to meet the pass threshold
categories.positive_example: Launch infrastructure policy and launch-services business
categories.confusing_negative: A transport office title implies an airline event

categories.evidence_required: Company is the actor or patient of a reported event
categories.decision_rule: A denial or rejection remains related; polarity is separate
categories.confusing_negative: Drop a company merely because event is negated

categories.evidence_required: Local comparison/attribution cue
categories.decision_rule: A comparison name is not automatically the subject of the event
categories.confusing_negative: Unlike Microsoft, university raises tuition

categories.evidence_required: Filing dates and explicit as-of cutoff
categories.decision_rule: Exclude future filings and reject future-dated source evidence
categories.positive_example: October event supported by September filing
categories.confusing_negative: October filing explains a July article in a backtest
categories.when_missing: Fail/abstain when dated proof is unavailable

categories.evidence_required: Dated acquisition/divestiture state
categories.decision_rule: Do not infer current product ownership from a historical statement
categories.confusing_negative: Previously divested business remains an owned alias

categories.evidence_required: Separate company and industry vocabularies
categories.decision_rule: Industry terms support sector context; specific stock links need separate evidence
categories.confusing_negative: drug/readout passes eight unrelated biotechs

categories.evidence_required: A unique product/business term with provenance
categories.decision_rule: Do not penalize an identifier for appearing in few industry members
categories.positive_example: VOXZOGO in a large biotech industry
categories.confusing_negative: Discard it because industry coverage is low

categories.evidence_required: Source-term identity across phrases/synonyms
categories.decision_rule: One underlying word cannot become three independent confirmations
categories.confusing_negative: drug + drug synonym + same word in industry gate

categories.evidence_required: Pair-specific evidence independent of comparison pool
categories.decision_rule: The same article/company pair must retain its decision under batch duplication/order changes
categories.positive_example: One or nine copies of the space memo
categories.confusing_negative: Crowded news day suppresses every pass

categories.evidence_required: Complete returned relevance set
categories.decision_rule: Do not cut passes to a display top-12/top-24 limit
categories.confusing_negative: Valid link removed by UI row cap
categories.when_missing: Separate presentation limits from decision output

categories.evidence_required: Complete expected ticker set
categories.decision_rule: Every unexpected pass is a false positive
categories.confusing_negative: Expected RKLB plus unrelated AAL accepted

categories.evidence_required: A labeled positive case
categories.decision_rule: Unknown on a positive is a missed link, never a successful safe answer
categories.confusing_negative: Abstain on every meaningful article

categories.evidence_required: Explicit truth_complete and label provenance
categories.decision_rule: Partial regression assertions cannot certify accuracy
categories.confusing_negative: Negative-only bug assertion reported as overall accuracy

categories.evidence_required: Archive manifest, expected filing count, text checksums
categories.decision_rule: Fail strict mode on incomplete/missing/corrupt text; label legacy caches incomplete
categories.confusing_negative: Capped SQLite cache presented as the full archive
categories.when_missing: Stop strict ingestion and report missing sources

categories.evidence_required: Positive/negative and per-category metrics
categories.decision_rule: Report precision, recall, exact-set accuracy and coverage; no all-negative certification
categories.positive_example: At least 20 positive cases and diverse examples
categories.confusing_negative: 100 irrelevant articles return unknown

categories.evidence_required: An observed mismatch outside this matrix
categories.decision_rule: Record a new category and lock a case before changing the implementation
categories.positive_example: New observed error with a reproducible case
categories.confusing_negative: Silently patch an individual word
